messages.content: 0 # gping 🚀 [![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/gping.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/gping) [![Actions Status](https://github.com/orf/gping/workflows/CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/orf/gping/actions) Ping, but with a graph. ![](./images/readme-example.gif) Comes with the following super-powers: * Graph the ping time for multiple hosts * Graph the _execution time_ for commands via the `--cmd` flag * Custom colours * Windows, Mac and Linux support Table of Contents ================= * [Install :cd:](#install-cd) * [Usage :saxophone:](#usage-saxophone) # Install :cd: * macOS * [Homebrew](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/gping#default): `brew install gping` * [MacPorts](https://ports.macports.org/port/gping/): `sudo port install gping` * Linux (Homebrew): `brew install gping` * CentOS (and other distributions with an old glibc): Download the MUSL build from the latest release * Windows/ARM: * Scoop: `scoop install gping` * Chocolatey: `choco install gping` * Download the latest release from [the github releases page](https://github.com/orf/gping/releases) * Fedora ([COPR](https://copr.fedorainfracloud.org/coprs/atim/gping/)): `sudo dnf copr enable atim/gping -y && sudo dnf install gping` * Cargo (**This requires `rustc` version 1.67.0 or greater**): `cargo install gping` * Arch Linux: `pacman -S gping` * Alpine linux: `apk add gping` * Ubuntu >23.10/Debian >13: `apt install gping` * Ubuntu/Debian ([Azlux's repo](https://packages.azlux.fr/)): ```bash echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/azlux.gpg] https://packages.azlux.fr/debian/ bookworm main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/azlux.list sudo apt install gpg curl -s https://azlux.fr/repo.gpg.key | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/azlux.gpg > /dev/null sudo apt update sudo apt install gping ``` * Gentoo ([dm9pZCAq overlay](https://github.com/gentoo-mirror/dm9pZCAq)): ```sh sudo eselect repository enable dm9pZCAq sudo emerge --sync dm9pZCAq sudo emerge net-misc/gping::dm9pZCAq ``` * FreeBSD: * [pkg](https://www.freshports.org/net-mgmt/gping/): `pkg install gping` * [ports](https://cgit.freebsd.org/ports/tree/net-mgmt/gping) `cd /usr/ports/net-mgmt/gping; make install clean` * Docker: ```sh # Check all options docker run --rm -ti --network host ghcr.io/orf/gping:gping-v1.15.1 --help # Ping google.com docker run --rm -ti --network host ghcr.io/orf/gping:gping-v1.15.1 google.com ``` * Flox: ```sh # Inside of a Flox environment flox install gping ``` * [gah](https://github.com/marverix/gah): ```sh gah install gping ``` # Usage :saxophone: Just run `gping [host]`. `host` can be a command like `curl google.com` if the `--cmd` flag is used. You can also use shorthands like `aws:eu-west-1` or `aws:ca-central-1` to ping specific cloud regions. Only `aws` is currently supported. ```bash $ gping --help Ping, but with a graph. Usage: gping [OPTIONS] [HOSTS_OR_COMMANDS]... Arguments: [HOSTS_OR_COMMANDS]... Hosts or IPs to ping, or commands to run if --cmd is provided. Can use cloud shorthands like aws:eu-west-1. Options: --cmd Graph the execution time for a list of commands rather than pinging hosts -n, --watch-interval Watch interval seconds (provide partial seconds like '0.5'). Default for ping is 0.2, default for cmd is 0.5. -b, --buffer Determines the number of seconds to display in the graph. [default: 30] -4 Resolve ping targets to IPv4 address -6 Resolve ping targets to IPv6 address -i, --interface Interface to use when pinging -s, --simple-graphics Uses dot characters instead of braille --vertical-margin Vertical margin around the graph (top and bottom) [default: 1] --horizontal-margin Horizontal margin around the graph (left and right) [default: 0] -c, --color Assign color to a graph entry. This option can be defined more than once as a comma separated string, and the order which the colors are provided will be matched against the hosts or commands passed to gping. {"command": "cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/sweep.py
import sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,"/tmp")
from cap import run
def get(vals, w=110,h=26,secs=5):
    open("/tmp/pvals.txt","w").write("\n".join(vals)+"\n")
    out=run(w,h,secs,"127.0.0.1")
    lines=out.split("\n")
    hdr=lines[1]
    lbls=[l.split("│")[0].strip() for l in lines[2:h-4] if "│" in l]
    lbls=[x for x in lbls if x]
    # rows of labels
    rows=[]
    for i,l in enumerate(lines[2:h-3]):
        pre=l.split("│")[0].strip()
        if pre: rows.append((i,pre))
    st=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)\s+avg (\S+)',hdr)
    return st.groups() if st else None, rows
def ms(s):
    s=s.strip()
    m=re.match(r'^([\d.]+)(ns|µs|ms|s)$',s)
    if not m: return None
    v=float(m.group(1)); u=m.group(2)
    return v*{"ns":1e-6,"µs":1e-3,"ms":1,"s":1000}[u]
for v in ["0.100","0.200","0.500","1.000","2.000","3.000","5.000","10.000","20.000","50.000"]:
    stats,rows=get([v])
    mn,mx=ms(rows[-1][1]),ms(rows[0][1])
    step=(mx-mn)/6
    print(f"val={v} stats={stats} top={rows[0][1]} bot={rows[-1][1]} step={step:.6f} step/max={step/ms(v):.5f} rows={[r for r,_ in rows]}")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/sweep.py"}

import sys,re

from cap import run
def get(vals, w=110,h=26,secs=5):
    open("/tmp/pvals.txt","w").write("\n".join(vals)+"\n")

        if pre: rows.append((i,pre))

import sys,re,time,subprocess
def run(w,h,secs,args):

    time.sleep(secs-0.6)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p","-N"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return r.stdout
def ms(s):
    s=s.strip()
    m=re.match(r'^([\d.]+)(ns|µs|ms|s)$',s)
    if not m: return None
    v=float(m.group(1)); u=m.group(2)
    return v*{"ns":1e-6,"µs":1e-3,"ms":1,"s":1000}[u]
def ticks(vals,w=110,h=26,secs=2.5,args="127.0.0.1"):

    lbl=[ (i,l.split("│")[0].strip()) for i,l in enumerate(lines) if "│" in l and l.split("│")[0].strip()]
    return stats.groups() if stats else None, lbl

import sys,re,time,subprocess
def _cmd(w,h,secs,args):
    return f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH timeout {secs} /workspace/executable {args}"
def run(w,h,secs,args,tries=4):
    for k in range(tries):
        subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        time.sleep(0.4)
        subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y",str(h),"-s","t1",_cmd(w,h,secs,args)])
        time.sleep(secs-0.5)

        if r.stdout.strip(): return r.stdout
        time.sleep(0.5)
    return ""
def ms(s):
    s=s.strip()
    m=re.match(r'^([\d.]+)(ns|µs|ms|s)$',s)
    if not m: return None
    v=float(m.group(1)); u=m.group(2)
    return v*{"ns":1e-6,"µs":1e-3,"ms":1,"s":1000}[u]

    lbl=[ (i,l.split("│")[0].strip()) for i,l in enumerate(lines) if "│" in l and l.split("│")[0].strip()]

def worker(i,w,h,secs,args,vals):

            print(f"### {args} vals={vals}")
            for l in r.stdout.split("\n"):
                if "│" in l and l.split("│")[0].strip():
                    print("   ", l.split("│")[0].strip())
            return
    print(f"### {args} vals={vals} FAILED")
def sweep(cases,w=110,h=26,secs=2.5,parallel=8):
    threads=[]
    for i,(args,vals) in enumerate(cases):
        t=threading.Thread(target=worker,args=(i,w,h,secs,args,vals)); t.start(); threads.append(t)
        if (i+1)%parallel==0:
            for t in threads: t.join()
            threads=[]
    for t in threads: t.join()

import sys,re,time,subprocess,os,threading
def worker(i,w,h,secs,args,vals):
    sock=f"/tmp/tm{i}.sock"
    open("/tmp/pvals.txt","a").write("")  # noop
    with open(f"/tmp/pv{i}.txt","w") as f: f.write("\n".join(vals)+"\n")
    env=dict(os.environ); env["PVFILE"]=f"/tmp/pv{i}.txt"
    cmd=f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH PVFILE={f.name} timeout {secs} /workspace/executable {args}"
    for k in range(3):
        subprocess.run(["tmux","-S",sock,"kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        time.sleep(0.2)
        subprocess.run(["tmux","-S",sock,"new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y",str(h),"-s",f"t{i}",cmd])
        time.sleep(secs-0.4)
        r=subprocess.run(["tmux","-S",sock,"capture-pane","-t",f"t{i}","-p","-N"],capture_output=True,text=True)
        if r.stdout.strip():
            print(f"### {args} vals={vals}")
            for l in r.stdout.split("\n"):
                if "│" in l and l.split("│")[0].strip():
                    print("   ", l.split("│")[0].strip())
            return
    print(f"### {args} vals={vals} FAILED")
def sweep(cases,w=110,h=26,secs=2.5,parallel=8):
    threads=[]
    for i,(args,vals) in enumerate(cases):
        t=threading.Thread(target=worker,args=(i,w,h,secs,args,vals)); t.start(); threads.append(t)
        if (i+1)%parallel==0:
            for t in threads: t.join()
            threads=[]
    for t in threads: t.join()

import subprocess,time,re
def hdr(vals,w=200,h=26,secs=6,args="127.0.0.1"):
    open("/tmp/pvals.txt","w").write("\n".join(vals)+"\n")
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.3)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y",str(h),"-s","t1",f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH timeout {secs} /workspace/executable {args}"])
    time.sleep(secs-1.0)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p","-N"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    l=r.stdout.split("\n")[1]
    m=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)\s+avg (\S+)\s+jtr (\S+)\s+p95 (\S+)\s+t/o (\S+)',l)
    return m.groups() if m else l
import statistics as st
cases=[["0.100","0.200","0.300","0.400","0.500"],
       ["0.100","0.200","0.300","0.400","0.500","0.600","0.700","0.800","0.900","1.000"],
       ["0.100","0.200"],
       ["0.100","0.900"],
       ["1.000","5.000"],
       ["0.100","0.100","0.100","0.100","0.200"]]
for v in cases:
    g=hdr(v)
    xs=[float(x)*1000 for x in v]  # µs
    diffs=[abs(xs[i]-xs[i-1]) for i in range(1,len(xs))]
    print(f"{str(v):70s} -> {g}  mean={st.mean(xs):.1f} std={st.pstdev(xs):.1f} mad={st.mean([abs(x-st.mean(xs)) for x in xs]):.1f} meandiff={st.mean(diffs):.1f} stddiff={st.pstdev(diffs):.1f}")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/avg2.py"}

#!/bin/bash
if [ "$1" = "-V" ]; then echo "ping from iputils-s20211203"; exit 0; fi

i=0
MODE=${MODE:-list}

BASE=${BASE:-100}
while true; do
  sleep ${SLEEP:-0.2}
  if [ "$MODE" = "ramp" ]; then
    v=$(python3 -c "print(($BASE + $SLOPE*$i)/1000.0)")
  elif [ "$MODE" = "sin" ]; then
    v=$(python3 -c "import math;print(($BASE + $SLOPE*math.sin($i/10.0))/1000.0)")
  else
    F=${PVFILE:-/tmp/pvals.txt}
    N=$(wc -l < "$F")
    v=$(sed -n "$(( (i % N) + 1 ))p" "$F")
  fi
  echo "64 bytes from $host: icmp_seq=$i ttl=64 time=${v} ms"
  i=$((i+1))
done
EOF

actions.command:
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/fakebin/ping
#!/bin/bash
if [ "$1" = "-V" ]; then echo "ping from iputils-s20211203"; exit 0; fi
host="$*"; host="${host#-O }"
echo "PING $host ($host) 56(84) bytes of data."
i=0
MODE=${MODE:-list}
SLOPE=${SLOPE:-10}
BASE=${BASE:-100}
while true; do
  sleep ${SLEEP:-0.2}
  if [ "$MODE" = "ramp" ]; then
    v=$(python3 -c "print(($BASE + $SLOPE*$i)/1000.0)")
  elif [ "$MODE" = "sin" ]; then
    v=$(python3 -c "import math;print(($BASE + $SLOPE*math.sin($i/10.0))/1000.0)")
  else
    F=${PVFILE:-/tmp/pvals.txt}
    N=$(wc -l < "$F")
    v=$(sed -n "$(( (i % N) + 1 ))p" "$F")
  fi
  echo "64 bytes from $host: icmp_seq=$i ttl=64 time=${v} ms"
  i=$((i+1))
done
EOF
cat <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/ramp.py
import subprocess,time,re,os
def run(mode,slope,base,secs=8,w=200,h=26,args="127.0.0.1"):
    env=dict(os.environ)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.3)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y",str(h),"-s","t1",f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH MODE={mode} SLOPE={slope} BASE={base} timeout {secs} /workspace/executable {args}"])
    time.sleep(secs-1.0)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p","-N"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    l=r.stdout.split("\n")[1]
    m=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)\s+avg (\S+)\s+jtr (\S+)\s+p95 (\S+)\s+t/o (\S+)',l)
    print(f"mode={mode} slope={slope} base={base} n_est={(secs-1)/0.208:.0f} -> {m.groups() if m else l}")
for s in [1,10,100,1000]:
    run("ramp",s,100)
run("ramp",10,100,secs=20)
run("ramp",100,100,secs=20)
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/ramp.py

PYEOF

import subprocess,time,re
def run(w,h,f,secs=6,tries=3):
    for k in range(tries):
        subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.5)
        subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y",str(h),"-s","t1",f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH PVFILE={f} timeout {secs} /workspace/executable 127.0.0.1"])
        time.sleep(secs-0.8)
        r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p","-N"],capture_output=True,text=True)
        ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
        if len(ls)>2:
            tl=[l for l in ls if re.search(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',l)]
            for l in tl:
                pos=[(m.start(),m.group()) for m in re.finditer(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',l)]
                print(f"  W={w} f={f} time_labels at {pos} linelen={len(l)}")
            axis=[i for i,l in enumerate(ls) if "└" in l][0]
            lw=len([l for l in ls if "│" in l and l.split("│")[0].strip()][0].split("│")[0])
            print(f"    labelarea={lw} axisrow={axis} timerow={axis+1}")
            return
    print(f"FAILED {f} w={w}")

for w in [60,80,100,120,160,200,240]:
    run(w,26,"/tmp/p01.txt")

actions.command:
cd /tmp && cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/fakebin/ping
#!/bin/bash
if [ "$1" = "-V" ]; then echo "ping from iputils-s20211203"; exit 0; fi
{ echo "ARGS: $@  PVFILE=$PVFILE"; } >> /tmp/pinglog.txt
host="$*"; host="${host#-O }"
echo "PING $host ($host) 56(84) bytes of data."
i=0
F=${PVFILE:-/tmp/pvals.txt}
N=$(wc -l < "$F")
while true; do
  sleep 0.2
  v=$(sed -n "$(( (i % N) + 1 ))p" "$F")
  echo "64 bytes from $host: icmp_seq=$i ttl=64 time=${v} ms"
  i=$((i+1))
done
EOF
printf '0.100\n' > /tmp/pvals.txt
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/fakebin/ping6
#!/bin/bash
if [ "$1" = "-V" ]; then echo "ping from iputils-s20211203"; exit 0; fi
{ echo "PING6 ARGS: $@"; } >> /tmp/pinglog.txt
host="$*"
echo "PING $host ($host) 56 data bytes"
i=0
while true; do
  sleep 0.2
  echo "64 bytes from $host: icmp_seq=$i ttl=64 time=0.100 ms"
  i=$((i+1))
done
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/fakebin/ping6
timeout 60 bash -c '
run() { rm -f /tmp/pinglog.txt; tmux kill-server 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.4; tmux new-session -d -x 100 -y 26 -s t1 "cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:\$PATH timeout 3 /workspace/executable $*"; sleep 2.5; echo "### $*"; cat /tmp/pinglog.txt 2>&1; }
run 127.0.0.1
run -n 0.5 127.0.0.1
run -n 1 127.0.0.1
run -i eth0 127.0.0.1
run -4 ::1
run -6 ::1
run --ping-args -c 3 -w 5 127.0.0.1
run --ping-args 127.0.0.1
run --cmd "sleep 0.3"
'

timeout 170 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import subprocess,time,re
def run(w,n,slp,b,secs=13,tries=2,args=""):
    for k in range(tries):
        subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.5)
        subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y",str(26),"-s","t1",f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH SLP={slp} timeout {secs} /workspace/executable -n {n} -b {b} {args} 127.0.0.1"])
        time.sleep(secs-0.8)
        r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p","-N"],capture_output=True,text=True)
        ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
        if len(ls)>3:
            best=None
            for i,l in enumerate(ls):
                pos=[j for j,c in enumerate(l) if 0x2800<=ord(c)<=0x28FF]
                if pos: 
                    s,e=min(pos),max(pos)
                    if best is None or e-0 > best[2]: best=(i,s,e,len(pos))
            print(f"W={w} n={n} slp={slp} b={b} -> data cols {best[1]}..{best[2]} (span {best[2]-best[1]+1}) at row {best[0]}")
            return
    print(f"W={w} n={n} slp={slp} b={b} FAILED")
run(100,0.2,0.4,30)   # configured 0.2, actual 0.4
run(100,0.2,0.2,30)
run(100,0.5,0.2,30)   # configured 0.5, actual 0.2
run(100,0.5,0.5,30)
PYEOF

actions.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
vs=[100+10*i for i in range(900)]
open('/tmp/pramp.txt','w').write('\n'.join(f'{v/1000.0:.3f}' for v in vs)+'\n')
" && timeout 170 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import subprocess,time,re
def run(w,b,f,secs=28,tries=2):
    for k in range(tries):
        subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.5)
        subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y",str(26),"-s","t1",f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH PVFILE={f} timeout {secs} /workspace/executable -b {b} 127.0.0.1"])
        time.sleep(secs-0.8)
        r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p","-N"],capture_output=True,text=True)
        ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
        if len(ls)>3:
            hdr=ls[1]
            m=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)\s+avg (\S+)',hdr)
            best=None
            for i,l in enumerate(ls):
                pos=[j for j,c in enumerate(l) if 0x2800<=ord(c)<=0x28FF]
                if pos:
                    s,e=min(pos),max(pos)
                    if best is None or e>best[2]: best=(i,s,e)
            print(f"W={w} b={b} f={f.split('/')[-1]} stats={m.groups() if m else '?'} -> row{best[0]} cols {best[1]}..{best[2]} span={best[2]-best[1]+1}")
            return
    print("FAILED")
run(200,2,"/tmp/pramp.txt")
run(200,2,"/tmp/pvals.txt")
run(200,30,"/tmp/pramp.txt")
PYEOF

def run(keys,args="",w=110,h=26,secs=6):

    for k in keys:
        subprocess.run(["tmux","send-keys","-t","t1",k])
        time.sleep(0.4)
    time.sleep(secs-3.0)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
    print(f"### keys={keys} args={args} -> first3={[l[:40] for l in ls[:3]]}")
    return r.stdout
# test q
o=run(["q"])
print("after q:", repr(o.split(chr(10))[0]), repr(o.split(chr(10))[1]) if len(o.split(chr(10)))>1 else "")

import os,pty,select,time,subprocess,sys,fcntl,termios,struct,re
def run(args,keys=b"",w=110,h=26,duration=4.0,env_extra="",after=1.0,fakepath=True):
    pid,fd=pty.fork()
    if pid==0:
        os.environ["TERM"]="xterm-256color"
        os.environ["COLUMNS"]=str(w); os.environ["LINES"]=str(h)
        if fakepath: os.environ["PATH"]="/tmp/fakebin:"+os.environ["PATH"]
        if env_extra:

        os.execv("/workspace/executable",["/workspace/executable"]+args.split() if args else ["/workspace/executable"])
    fcntl.ioctl(fd,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack("HHHH",h,w,0,0))
    out=b""
    t0=time.time()
    sent=False
    while time.time()-t0<duration:
        r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.1)
        if r:

            except OSError: break
            if not d: break

        if not sent and keys and time.time()-t0>duration-1.0:

import sys,os; sys.path.insert(0,"/tmp")
from t import *
import re
def measure(w,b,secs):
    for k in range(2):
        killpings()
        start(f"-b {b} 127.0.0.1",w,26,secs)
        time.sleep(secs-0.8)
        o=cap()
        ls=o.split("\n")
        if len(ls)>4: break
    cols=set()
    for i,l in enumerate(ls):
        for j,c in enumerate(l):
            if 0x2800<=ord(c)<=0x28FF: cols.add(j)
    m=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)',ls[1])
    lw=len([l for l in ls if "│" in l and l.split("│")[0].strip()][0].split("│")[0])
    area=w-lw-1  # columns of data area
    if cols:
        print(f"W={w} b={b} secs={secs} stats={m.groups() if m else '?'} labelw={lw} area={area} data {min(cols)}..{max(cols)} span={max(cols)-min(cols)+1} frac={(max(cols)-min(cols)+1)/area:.3f} startoff={min(cols)-(lw+1)}")
    else:
        print(f"W={w} b={b} secs={secs} NO DATA stats={m.groups() if m else '?'}")
    killpings()
for b,secs in [(30,5),(30,10),(30,20),(30,32)]:
    measure(200,b,secs)

import subprocess,time,re
def meas(v,w,secs=2.2):
    open("/tmp/pvals.txt","w").write(v+"\n")
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.25)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y","26","-s","t1",f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH timeout {secs} /workspace/executable 127.0.0.1"])
    time.sleep(secs-0.25)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
    lw=None
    for l in ls:
        if "│" in l and l.split("│")[0].strip(): lw=len(l.split("│")[0]); break
    tl=[l for l in ls if re.search(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',l)]
    pos=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',tl[0])] if tl else []
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    subprocess.run("for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | awk '/\\/tmp\\/fakebin\\/ping/ && !/awk/ {print $1}'); do kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null; done",shell=True)
    return lw,pos

for w in [80,84,88,92,96,100,104,108,112,116,120,124,128]:
    lw,pos=meas("0.100",w)
    res.append((w,lw,pos))
    print(f"W={w} lw={lw} pos={pos} mid-W/2={pos[1]-w//2 if len(pos)>1 else '?'}")
PYEOF

import subprocess,time,re
def meas(args,w=100,secs=2.5):
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.25)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y","26","-s","t1",f"cd /tmp; PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH timeout {secs} /workspace/executable {args}"])
    time.sleep(secs-0.2)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
    tl=[l for l in ls if re.search(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',l)]
    pos=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',tl[0])] if tl else []
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    subprocess.run("for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | awk '/\\/tmp\\/fakebin\\/ping/ && !/awk/ {print $1}'); do kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null; done",shell=True)
    return pos
for b in ["5","30","60","300"]:
    print(f"-b {b} -> {meas(f'-b {b} 127.0.0.1')}")
print("with 2 hosts:", meas("127.0.0.1 127.0.0.2"))
print("with -s:", meas("-s 127.0.0.1"))
print("with margins:", meas("--vertical-margin 2 --horizontal-margin 3 127.0.0.1",w=120))
PYEOF

pub fn get_ping_cmd(addr: std::net::IpAddr, interval: f64, iface: Option<&str>, extra: &[String]) -> Command {
    let mut cmd = if addr.is_ipv6() { Command::new("ping6") } else { Command::new("ping") };
    cmd.arg("-O");
    cmd.arg(format!("-i{:.1}", interval));
    if let Some(i) = iface { cmd.arg(format!("-I{}", i)); }
    cmd.args(extra);
    cmd.arg(addr.to_string());
    cmd
}

    if addr.is_ipv6() { Command::new("ping6") } else { Command::new("ping") }
}

pub fn get_ping_cmd(addr: std::net::IpAddr, interval: f64, iface: Option<&str>, extra: &[String]) -> Command {

use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct PingResult {
    pub seq: usize,
    pub time: Duration,   // 0 for timeout
    pub timeout: bool,
}

pub fn get_ping_cmd(addr: std::net::IpAddr, interval: f64, iface: Option<&str>, extra: &[String]) -> Command {
    let mut cmd = if addr.is_ipv6() { Command::new("ping6") } else { Command::new("ping") };
    cmd.arg("-O");
    cmd.arg(format!("-i{:.1}", interval));
    if let Some(i) = iface { cmd.arg(format!("-I{}", i)); }
    cmd.args(extra);
    cmd.arg(addr.to_string());
    cmd
}

pub fn get_ping_version_cmd(addr: IpAddr) -> Command {
    if addr.is_ipv6() { Command::new("ping6") } else { Command::new("ping") }
}

pub fn get_ping_cmd(addr: std::net::IpAddr, interval: f64, iface: Option<&str>, extra: &[String]) -> Command {
    let mut cmd = if addr.is_ipv6() { Command::new("ping6") } else { Command::new("ping") };

    if let Some(i) = iface { cmd.arg(format!("-I{}", i)); }
    cmd.args(extra);
    cmd.arg(addr.to_string());
    cmd
}

}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Line {
    /// `x` of the starting point
    pub x1: f64,
    /// `y` of the starting point
    pub y1: f64,
    /// `x` of the ending point
    pub x2: f64,
    /// `y` of the ending point
    pub y2: f64,
    /// Color of the line
    pub color: Color,
}

impl Line {
    /// Create a new line from `(x1, y1)` to `(x2, y2)` with the given color
    pub const fn new(x1: f64, y1: f64, x2: f64, y2: f64, color: Color) -> Self {
        Self {
            x1,
            y1,
            x2,
            y2,
            color,
        }
    }
}

impl Shape for Line {
    #[expect(clippy::similar_names)]
    fn draw(&self, painter: &mut Painter) {
        let (x_bounds, y_bounds) = painter.bounds();
        let Some((world_x1, world_y1, world_x2, world_y2)) =
            clip_line(x_bounds, y_bounds, self.x1, self.y1, self.x2, self.y2)
        else {
            return;
        };
        let Some((x1, y1)) = painter.get_point(world_x1, world_y1) else {
            return;
        };
        let Some((x2, y2)) = painter.get_point(world_x2, world_y2) else {
            return;
        };

        draw_line(painter, x1, y1, x2, y2, self.color);
    }
}

fn clip_line(
    &[xmin, xmax]: &[f64; 2],
    &[ymin, ymax]: &[f64; 2],
    x1: f64,
    y1: f64,
    x2: f64,
    y2: f64,
) -> Option<(f64, f64, f64, f64)> {
    if let Some(LineSegment {
        p1: Point { x: x1, y: y1 },
        p2: Point { x: x2, y: y2 },
    }) = cohen_sutherland::clip_line(
        LineSegment::new(Point::new(x1, y1), Point::new(x2, y2)),
        Window::new(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax),
    ) {
        Some((x1, y1, x2, y2))
    } else {
        None
    }
}

pub(super) fn draw_line(
    painter: &mut Painter,
    x1: usize,
    y1: usize,
    x2: usize,
    y2: usize,
    color: Color,
) {
    for_each_line_point(x1, y1, x2, y2, |x, y| painter.paint(x, y, color));
}

/// Calls `f(x, y)` for each pixel on the Bresenham line from `(x1, y1)` to `(x2, y2)`.  
pub(super) fn for_each_line_point<F>(x1: usize, y1: usize, x2: usize, y2: usize, mut f: F)
where
    F: FnMut(usize, usize),
{
    let dx = x2.abs_diff(x1);
    let dy = y2.abs_diff(y1);

    if dx == 0 {
        for y in y1.min(y2)..=y1.max(y2) {
            f(x1, y);
        }
    } else if dy == 0 {
        for x in x1.min(x2)..=x1.max(x2) {
            f(x, y1);
        }
    } else if dy < dx {
        if x1 > x2 {
            for_each_line_point_low(x2, y2, x1, y1, f);
        } else {
            for_each_line_point_low(x1, y1, x2, y2, f);
        }
    } else if y1 > y2 {
        for_each_line_point_high(x2, y2, x1, y1, f);
    } else {
        for_each_line_point_high(x1, y1, x2, y2, f);
    }
}

fn for_each_line_point_low<F>(x1: usize, y1: usize, x2: usize, y2: usize, mut f: F)
where
    F: FnMut(usize, usize),
{
    let dx = (x2 - x1) as isize;
    let dy = (y2 as isize - y1 as isize).abs();
    let mut d = 2 * dy - dx;
    let mut y = y1;
    for x in x1..=x2 {
        f(x, y);
        if d > 0 {
            y = if y1 > y2 {
                y.saturating_sub(1)
            } else {
                y.saturating_add(1)
            };
            d -= 2 * dx;
        }
        d += 2 * dy;
    }
}

fn for_each_line_point_high<F>(x1: usize, y1: usize, x2: usize, y2: usize, mut f: F)
where
    F: FnMut(usize, usize),
{
    let dx = (x2 as isize - x1 as isize).abs();
    let dy = (y2 - y1) as isize;
    let mut d = 2 * dx - dy;
    let mut x = x1;
    for y in y1..=y2 {
        f(x, y);
        if d > 0 {
            x = if x1 > x2 {
                x.saturating_sub(1)
            } else {
                x.saturating_add(1)
            };
            d -= 2 * dy;
        }
        d += 2 * dx;
    }
}

    /// Convert the `(x, y)` coordinates to location of a point on the grid
    ///
    /// `(x, y)` coordinates are expressed in the coordinate system of the canvas. The origin is in
    /// the lower left corner of the canvas (unlike most other coordinates in `Ratatui` where the
    /// origin is the upper left corner). The `x` and `y` bounds of the canvas define the specific
    /// area of some coordinate system that will be drawn on the canvas. The resolution of the grid
    /// is used to convert the `(x, y)` coordinates to the location of a point on the grid.
    ///
    /// The grid coordinates are expressed in the coordinate system of the grid. The origin is in
    /// the top left corner of the grid. The x and y bounds of the grid are always `[0, width - 1]`
    /// and `[0, height - 1]` respectively. The resolution of the grid is used to convert the
    /// `(x, y)` coordinates to the location of a point on the grid.
    ///
    /// Points are rounded to the nearest grid cell (with points exactly in the center of a cell
    /// rounding up).
    ///
    /// # Examples
    ///
    /// ```
    /// use ratatui::symbols;
    /// use ratatui::widgets::canvas::{Context, Painter};
    ///
    /// let mut ctx = Context::new(2, 2, [1.0, 2.0], [0.0, 2.0], symbols::Marker::Braille);
    /// let mut painter = Painter::from(&mut ctx);
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(1.0, 0.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, Some((0, 7)));
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(1.5, 1.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, Some((2, 4)));
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(0.0, 0.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, None);
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(2.0, 2.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, Some((3, 0)));
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(1.0, 2.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, Some((0, 0)));
    /// ```
    pub fn get_point(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
        let [left, right] = self.context.x_bounds;
        let [bottom, top] = self.context.y_bounds;
        if x < left || x > right || y < bottom || y > top {
            return None;
        }
        let width = right - left;
        let height = top - bottom;
        if width <= 0.0 || height <= 0.0 {
            return None;
        }
        let x = ((x - left) * (self.resolution.0 - 1.0) / width).round() as usize;
        let y = ((top - y) * (self.resolution.1 - 1.0) / height).round() as usize;
        Some((x, y))
    }

{"command": "cd /tmp && python3 -c "
vs=[100+1000*i for i in range(900)]

" && timeout 175 python3 - <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tail -8
import subprocess,time,re
def m(b,secs=6):
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.4)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x","110","-y","26","-s","t1",f"PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH timeout {secs} /workspace/executable -b {b} 127.0.0.1"])
    time.sleep(secs-0.4)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
    cols=set()
    for l in ls:
        for j,c in enumerate(l):
            if 0x2800<=ord(c)<=0x28FF: cols.add(j)
    mm=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)',ls[1])
    tl=[l for l in ls if re.search(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',l)]
    pos=[x.start() for x in re.finditer(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',tl[0])] if tl else []
    print(f"-b {b:4s} stats={mm.groups() if mm else '?'} cols {min(cols)}..{max(cols)} span={max(cols)-min(cols)+1} times={pos}")
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
for b in ["30","60","100","200","300"]:
    m(b)
PYEOF
sleep 1; for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | awk '/\/tmp\/fakebin\/ping/ && !/awk/ {print $1}'); do kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null; done; true"}

actions.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
vs=[100+1000*i for i in range(900)]
open('/tmp/pvals.txt','w').write('\n'.join(f'{v/1000.0:.3f}' for v in vs)+'\n')
" && timeout 175 python3 - <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tail -8
import subprocess,time,re
def m(b,secs=6):
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.4)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x","110","-y","26","-s","t1",f"PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH timeout {secs} /workspace/executable -b {b} 127.0.0.1"])
    time.sleep(secs-0.4)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
    cols=set()
    for l in ls:
        for j,c in enumerate(l):
            if 0x2800<=ord(c)<=0x28FF: cols.add(j)
    mm=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)',ls[1])
    tl=[l for l in ls if re.search(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',l)]
    pos=[x.start() for x in re.finditer(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d',tl[0])] if tl else []
    print(f"-b {b:4s} stats={mm.groups() if mm else '?'} cols {min(cols)}..{max(cols)} span={max(cols)-min(cols)+1} times={pos}")
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
for b in ["30","60","100","200","300"]:
    m(b)
PYEOF
sleep 1; for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | awk '/\/tmp\/fakebin\/ping/ && !/awk/ {print $1}'); do kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null; done; true

import subprocess,time,re
def m(args,secs=6,w=200):
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.4)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y","26","-s","t1",f"PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH timeout {secs} /workspace/executable {args}"])
    time.sleep(secs-0.4)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
    cols=set()
    for l in ls:
        for j,c in enumerate(l):
            if 0x2800<=ord(c)<=0x28FF: cols.add(j)
    mm=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)',ls[1])
    print(f"{args:30s} stats={mm.groups() if mm else '?'} cols {min(cols) if cols else '-'}..{max(cols) if cols else '-'} span={(max(cols)-min(cols)+1) if cols else 0}")
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

m("-n 1 127.0.0.1")

actions.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
vs=[100+1000*i for i in range(900)]
open('/tmp/pvals.txt','w').write('\n'.join(f'{v/1000.0:.3f}' for v in vs)+'\n')
" && timeout 120 python3 - <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tail -5
import subprocess,time,re
def m(args,secs=6,w=200):
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); time.sleep(0.4)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-x",str(w),"-y","26","-s","t1",f"PATH=/tmp/fakebin:$PATH timeout {secs} /workspace/executable {args}"])
    time.sleep(secs-0.4)
    r=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","t1","-p"],capture_output=True,text=True)
    ls=r.stdout.split("\n")
    cols=set()
    for l in ls:
        for j,c in enumerate(l):
            if 0x2800<=ord(c)<=0x28FF: cols.add(j)
    mm=re.search(r'last (\S+)\s+min (\S+)\s+max (\S+)',ls[1])
    print(f"{args:30s} stats={mm.groups() if mm else '?'} cols {min(cols) if cols else '-'}..{max(cols) if cols else '-'} span={(max(cols)-min(cols)+1) if cols else 0}")
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-server"],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
m("-n 0.5 127.0.0.1")
m("-n 0.2 127.0.0.1")
m("-n 1 127.0.0.1")
PYEOF
sleep 1; for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | awk '/\/tmp\/fakebin\/ping/ && !/awk/ {print $1}'); do kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null; done; true
